law.catch_line: When form of certificate of acknowledgment accepted
law.text:
The form of a certificate of acknowledgment used by a person whose authority is recognized under § 55.1-616 shall be accepted in the Commonwealth if:
The certificate is in a form prescribed by the laws or regulations of the Commonwealth;
The certificate is in a form prescribed by the laws or regulations applicable in the place in which the acknowledgment is taken; or
The certificate contains the words "acknowledged before me" or their substantial equivalent.
